from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document record containing its title and case cause."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as written in the text")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific case cause (案由) explicitly recorded in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed results for a single judgment document."""
    records: list[JudgmentRecord]
